articles.title: AWS Open-Sources Dogwood, Extending Cedar to Govern Sequences of Agent Tool Calls
articles.author: Steef-Jan Wiggers
articles.summary: AWS has open-sourced Dogwood, a policy language extending Cedar with temporal conditions so rules can reason about an agent's prior tool calls rather than one request in isolation. It covers approvals, rate limits and running totals, ships under Apache 2.0, and is supported in AgentCore Policy, though the reference interpreter is not production-ready. By Steef-Jan Wiggers

articles.title: AWS Introduces Native Vector Search for DynamoDB
articles.author: Renato Losio
articles.summary: Amazon DynamoDB recently introduced native vector search, allowing developers to store embeddings alongside application data and run approximate nearest-neighbor queries directly from DynamoDB without using a separate vector database. The feature supports filtered similarity searches and configurable vector indexes for semantic search workloads. By Renato Losio
